keyVerseDR: "Jesus stood in the midst of them and saith to them: Peace be to you. It is I: Fear not." (Lk 24:36)

level1.title: Jesus Eats Fish
level1.story: Jesus came to His friends and said, "Peace be with you!" They were afraid, so He showed them His hands and feet. Jesus even ate some fish!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Why did Jesus show His hands?
level1.prayer: Risen Jesus, give me Your peace. Amen.

activity.title: Words of peace
activity.intro: Jesus said, "Peace be with you." Write kind words for a friend.

level2.title: Touch and See
level2.story: The two disciples told how they had known Jesus in the breaking of the bread. While they were speaking, Jesus stood in the midst of them and said, "Peace be to you." They were frightened and thought they saw a spirit. Jesus said, "See My hands and feet, that it is I Myself," and He ate a piece of broiled fish before them. Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures and said they would be His witnesses.
level2.keyLine: Peace be to you. It is I: Fear not.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus eat in front of them?
How are you a witness to Jesus?
actions: Share my faith with a friend
level2.prayer: Risen Lord, open my mind to Your word. Amen.

activity.title: Gospel acclamation
activity.text: Lord Jesus, open the Scriptures to us; make our hearts burn while You speak to us.

art.mainBrief: Risen Jesus eating fish with startled disciples
